ani: heads-up: prod-eu embeddings spiking 502s for micro-prompts since 09:12 UTC. Root cause looks like an off-by-one in tokenizer split logic. I built tokenizer-v2.3.2-hotfix.

tom: can you confirm staging pass and e2e?

ani: staging smoke + integration passed. e2e small suite green. ready for staged canary 5% -> 30% -> 100% in 25m if ops ok.

ops-duty: oncall ack. Provide rollback criteria and Dedicated pin sha before I approve. Also request 30m change window.

ani: rollback rules: auto-rollback if 5xx rate up >2% absolute sustained 4m OR p95 latency +200ms. manual rollback: `/deploybot rollback --svc embedder --to previous`. Dedicated pin: sha256:baadf00d1234beef...cafebabe. CS blurb queued.

deploybot: deploybot: starting staged rollout service=embedder image=tokenizer-v2.3.2-hotfix steps=5,30,100 auto-rollback=enabled.

frank: sec quick review done, no new scopes.

ops-duty: granting expedite. change window +30m from canary start. paging set at error spike >1.5%.

deploybot: canary 5% applied to prod-eu. monitoring 5m window.

ani: 5% look good at 6m, moving to 30%.

deploybot: canary 30% applied. telemetry hold 10m.

tom: metrics good at 30%. proceed to 100%.

deploybot: ramping to 100%...

deploybot: rollout complete: service=embedder image=tokenizer-v2.3.2-hotfix. No rollbacks triggered.

ops-duty: closing expedite window. tagging post-deploy verification tasks.

ani: will post a 2h verification summary here. thanks everyone.
